title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2610.39409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespec

translated_title: 安全多目标强化学习：零约束违反与原始平均收敛
translated_abstract: 多目标强化学习（MORL）的许多应用需要策略在平衡相互冲突的目标的同时满足安全约束。我们研究了在整个学习过程中实现零约束违反的安全MORL，涵盖累积约束和逐步约束两种情形。一个关键挑战是在未知动力学和约束代价下进行充分探索而不违反约束。对于给定的目标偏好，我们开发了一种算法，通过结合乐观的奖励估计与悲观的成本界限来学习安全的帕累托最优策略。以高概率，在 $T$ 个回合中执行的每个策略均不产生任何约束违反。该算法返回由平均占用度量诱导的安全马尔可夫策略，并在光滑Tchebycheff标量化下实现了 $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的次优差距。我们进一步开发了一种无需预设偏好的算法，该算法首先在没有预指（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了安全多目标强化学习算法，通过结合乐观奖励估计与悲观成本界限，在整个学习过程中实现零约束违反，并在光滑Tchebycheff标量化下获得次优差距收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops safe multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithms that guarantee zero constraint violation throughout learning by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds, achieving suboptimality gap convergence under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization.
